<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="y8p-GQ6z6ft1YbIDzbrh"> <mxGraphModel dx="2580" dy="1813" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor Client
 participant PC as PaymentController
 participant WC as RazorpayWebhookController
 participant PO as PaymentOrchestrator
 participant PSF as PaymentServiceFactory
 participant RS as RazorpayService
 participant GW as RazorpayGateway
 participant INV as InventoryService

 alt Client-initiated verify
 Client->>PC: PaymentVerifyRequest
 PC->>PO: verifyPayment(request)
 else Razorpay server webhook
 WC->>PO: verifyWebhook(paymentId, orderId)
 end

 PO->>PO: findPaymentByGatewayOrderId()
 PO->>PO: idempotency check (already SUCCESS?)
 PO->>PSF: getPaymentService(\"ONLINE\")
 PSF-->>PO: RazorpayService
 PO->>RS: verifyPayment(payment, request)
 RS->>GW: verify signature / fetch payment
 GW-->>RS: gateway result
 PO->>PO: finalizePayment(payment)
 alt invoice still payable & stock available
 PO->>INV: deductStock(product, qty)
 PO->>PO: payment.markSuccess() / invoice.markPaid()
 else invoice already paid/canceled or stock insufficient
 PO->>RS: refund(payment)
 RS->>GW: refundPayment()
 PO->>PO: payment.markRefunded()
 end
 PO-->>PC: PaymentResponse",
 "config": null
